findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: border_check_cors, border_check_cors_headers · Private data: border_check_cors, border_check_cors_headers · Public sink: border_check_cors, border_check_cors_headers · Destructive: border_check_cors, border_check_cors_headers.
